name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Resolution on the case of José Daniel Ferrer García in Cuba
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It calls on Cuba to release José Daniel Ferrer García and all political prisoners held for speaking out or protesting peacefully. It condemns torture and poor treatment of prisoners and asks that families be allowed to see them and that they get medical care. It also asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Cuban officials responsible for human rights violations.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only asks Cuba to free Ferrer and other political prisoners.
- The requests target Cuba's government and its prisoners, including Ferrer and other detainees.
- Next, the resolution is sent to Cuba, European Union officials, member states and international bodies.
